┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                    │
│   Click the ground to walk there; the server plans the route, inside this    │
│   zone. The first click on a mob or a person selects it and opens a small    │
│   card (name, title, level, difficulty, what they offer); a second click, or │
│   F (attack) or G (talk), acts. A first click never attacks. Click loot to   │
│   pick up everything within reach.                                           │
│   Hover for a name and title beside the pointer. Hold Alt over the map to    │
│   name everything on it; if your terminal does not send Alt with the mouse,  │
│   Ctrl+A turns the names on and off. The wheel zooms (+ and - do too). M     │
│   opens the large map: click a spot to walk there, or move the cursor with   │
│   the arrows and press Enter.                                                │
│   Right-click lets go of the selection, as Esc does. Shift+click is never    │
│   used: terminals keep it for selecting text.                                │
│   Every mouse action has a key: arrows or WASD walk, Tab selects, F and G    │
│   act, L loots, + and - zoom, Ctrl+A names. The game is fully playable       │
│   without a mouse.                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ The character sidebar                                                        │
│   Beside a trader, a trainer, the bank, a contract board or a conversation   │
│ Page 3 of 8  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
